pages.text: {{hero}} has a rocket ship. It is red and black, with a big hatch. {{hero}} sits in it and hits the switch. Blast off! Up it zips to space.
{{hero}} wants to land on a big red rock in space and get a chunk of it for Mom. {{hero}} spots the rock and zips at it fast.
But the rocket gets stuck in a thick fog of dust. {{hero}} can not spot the red rock. It is lost in the dust.
Then {{hero}} hits the big lamp switch. Flash! The lamp cuts the dust, and there is the red rock. {{hero}} lands with a soft bump and gets a chunk.
At last, {{hero}} is snug in bed with the red chunk. But then the chunk went blink, blink, blink! What is in it?
